purpose: Interpret one explicit axis-aligned rectangular prism as a provenance-bound primitive parameter contract without choosing a modeling method.
trigger: One source describes exactly one rectangular prism with three positive extents, units, an explicit minimum corner, and a +X/+Y/+Z orientation, with no additional feature requiring interpretation.

inputs.name: source_manifest
inputs.type: one or more hash-bound source records
inputs.description: Readable source material and stable locators for every accepted value.

inputs.name: user_intent
inputs.description: Requested name or acceptance intent, kept distinct from observed source content.

preconditions: The source resolves to exactly one candidate solid with no holes, rounds, chamfers, patterns, or additional bodies.
Three finite positive extents and their units are explicit; pixel scale is not used as an unsourced dimension.
The minimum corner and axis-aligned positive-XYZ orientation are explicit; otherwise the handoff requires clarification.

outputs.name: primitive
outputs.description: Body name, minimum corner, three sizes, fixed orientation, and provenance for each field.

outputs.name: expected_geometry
outputs.description: Body count, minimum and maximum bounds, and volume derived from the primitive parameters.

outputs.name: unresolved_items
outputs.description: Any missing or conflicting primitive parameter that prevents a ready handoff.

postconditions: A ready output describes exactly one axis-aligned rectangular prism and has no unresolved item.
Every accepted parameter names its source and locator; inferred or missing values are not silently converted into user values.
Maximum bounds equal minimum corner plus size and volume equals the product of the three sizes.
The operation does not choose a construction sequence or invoke SpaceClaim.

implementation.target_environment: Visual or textual reasoning only; no SpaceClaim runtime.
implementation.notes: The host checker validates emitted contract invariants but does not perform source interpretation.

ambiguity_checks: Reject this template when any additional feature, body, missing extent, unresolved unit, or unresolved orientation changes the geometry.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Not applicable because this operation does not access model topology.

failure_modes.condition: A declared source or locator cannot be read or hash-bound.
failure_modes.detection: Check source existence, digest, and locator before interpretation.
failure_modes.safe_state: No ready primitive contract is emitted.

failure_modes.condition: The source supports another primitive, another body, or an extra feature.
failure_modes.detection: Inventory visible and textual features before matching the trigger.
failure_modes.safe_state: Return requires_clarification or the generic geometry-understanding workflow.

failure_modes.condition: An extent, unit, minimum corner, or orientation is missing or conflicting.
failure_modes.detection: Audit every required field and its provenance.
failure_modes.safe_state: Retain the item as unresolved and block downstream generation.

recovery.action: Repair or replace the source record, then rerun interpretation.
Use the generic workflow or request the smallest source clarification that distinguishes the geometry.
Obtain the missing value or preserve requires_clarification; never supply a silent default.

validation.method: Validate the output with the bound JSON Schema and host checker.
validation.expected: Required fields, provenance references, source hashes, positive sizes, derived bounds, and volume are consistent.

validation.method: Review trigger, inputs, outputs, and failure gates against the atomic contract.
validation.expected: No case number, fixed dimension, industry label, construction strategy, or application action is embedded.

evidence_level.notes: Host evidence validates declared invariants only; independent unseen-source interpretation evaluation is still required before activation.
